\newcommand{\BodyDraw}[2]{%
\begin{scope}
  \edef\bodyvertices{\csname BodyVertices#1\endcsname}
  \edef\bodyfaces{\csname BodyFaces#1\endcsname}
  \edef\bodymarks{\csname BodyMarks#1\endcsname}
  \foreach \id/\xx/\yy in \bodyvertices
    \coordinate (body-\id) at (\xx,\yy);
  \foreach \va/\vb/\vc/\shade/\tone/\reflectance/\unc in \bodyfaces {
    \ifcase#2
      \def\facetcolor{blue!\tone!white}
      \def\edgecolor{white!48!blue}
    \or
      \def\facetcolor{black!\shade}
      \let\edgecolor\facetcolor
    \or
      \def\facetcolor{black!\reflectance}
      \let\edgecolor\facetcolor
    \or
      \edef\facetcolor{unc\unc}
      \let\edgecolor\facetcolor
    \fi
    \path[fill=\facetcolor,draw=\edgecolor,line width=.22pt,line join=round]
      (body-\va)--(body-\vb)--(body-\vc)--cycle;
  }
  \ifnum#2=0
    \draw[white!90,line width=.8pt,densely dashed]
      \csname BodyTrack#1\endcsname;
  \fi
  \foreach \rx/\ry/\bx/\by in \bodymarks {
    \draw[white,line width=2pt] (\rx,\ry) circle[radius=.095];
    \draw[blue,line width=1pt] (\rx,\ry) circle[radius=.095];
    \draw[white,line width=2pt] ({\bx-.09},{\by-.09}) rectangle ++(.18,.18);
    \draw[orange,line width=1pt] ({\bx-.09},{\by-.09}) rectangle ++(.18,.18);
  }
\end{scope}
}
\newcommand{\BodyMesh}{%
\BodyDraw{A}{0}
}
\newcommand{\BodyPhoto}[1]{%
\path[fill=ink!95,draw=ink!25,rounded corners=1mm] (0,0) rectangle (3.3,3.3);
\begin{scope}[shift={(1.65,1.65)},scale=.97]\BodyDraw{#1}{1}\end{scope}
}
\newcommand{\BodyMap}[1]{%
\path[fill=blue!3,draw=blue!16,rounded corners=1mm] (0,0) rectangle (3.3,3.3);
\begin{scope}[shift={(1.65,1.65)},scale=.97]\BodyDraw{A}{#1}\end{scope}
}
\newcommand{\BodyAlbedo}{%
\BodyMap{2}
}
\newcommand{\BodyUncertainty}{%
\BodyMap{3}
}
